a: Hypothesis is a popular property-based testing library for Python.
Coverage-guided fuzzers prioritize inputs that explore new paths.
Differential testing compares outputs of two implementations.
Metamorphic testing uses relations between inputs and outputs.
Fault injection deliberately triggers error paths.
Canary users receive new versions first for real-world signal.
Dark launches run new code without exposing results to users.
Test both flag on and flag off paths.
Assert that critical operations emit expected metrics/logs.
Traffic replay tests new versions against recorded requests carefully.
